DALBHARAT: Upcoming Board Decisions Will Shape Earnings Outlook And Forward P/E
news.body: Analysts have slightly reduced their fair value estimate for Dalmia Bharat, adjusting the price target from about ₹1,860 to around ₹1,852 as they incorporate updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins and future P/E into their models. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for April 28, 2026, to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider recommending a final dividend on equity shares for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

news.title: Final dividend of ₹5.00 announced
news.body: Dividend of ₹5.00 is the same as last year. Ex-date: 23rd June 2026 Payment date: 30th July 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.5%, which is about the same as the industry average. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by both earnings (15% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (76% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 24% per year over the past 7 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 39% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: DALBHARAT: Upcoming Results And Dividend Decision Will Shape Earnings Outlook And Forward P/E
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Dalmia Bharat slightly from ₹1,870 to about ₹1,860, citing updated assumptions that combine a lower revenue growth outlook with a higher profit margin profile and a modestly reduced forward P/E multiple. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for Apr 28, 2026 to review and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended Mar 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with expectations, revenues disappoint
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹60.78 (up from ₹36.42 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹150.3b (up 7.5% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹11.4b (up 67% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.6% (up from 4.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.9%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 8.9% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 1.4% decline forecast for the Basic Materials industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 2% per year whereas the company’s share price has fallen by 2% per year.

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 16%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2027 has deteriorated. 2027 revenue forecast decreased from ₹166.5b to ₹164.4b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹72.56 per share to ₹60.59 per share. Net income forecast to shrink 3.6% next year vs 10% growth forecast for Basic Materials industry in India . Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹2,285. Share price fell 2.2% to ₹1,950 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.50 (up from ₹3.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹35.1b (up 10% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.22b (up 100% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.5% (up from 1.9% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 24%. Revenue is forecast to grow 10% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, while revenues in the Basic Materials industry in India are expected to remain flat. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 3% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 7% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
